rationale: The reviewer found the mechanism: the variant-level random split puts test variants in training genes whose labels are near-uniform. They measured a gene label-rate baseline AUROC of 0.926 against the model's 0.941, and a conservation-only AUROC of 0.55, both matching the key. They proposed a gene-level split, within-gene evaluation and a gene-prior baseline; their other points (diagnostic use on unseen genes, a single split with no CIs) restate the same mechanism or are generic.
